name: Starter
summary: Personal and team timekeeping with live timers, manual entries, basic reports, and mobile-friendly workflows.
bestFor: Solo operators and small teams that need clean time capture before adding billing complexity.

name: Pro
summary: Adds clients, projects, tasks, invoicing, PDF export, and payment links.
bestFor: Professional services teams that bill clients from tracked time.

name: Business
summary: Adds shift management, add/drop marketplace, swaps, chat, subordinate reporting, and approvals.
bestFor: Shift-based teams and growing operations with managers, schedules, and approvals.

name: Legal
summary: Adds UTBMS codes, matters, conflict checks, LEDES 1998B export, trust ledger, and custom rate tables.
bestFor: Law firms that need legal billing controls and matter-aware timekeeping.
